newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks close moderately lower in light trade.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks close moderately lower in light trade.

text.p: Tokyo stocks closed moderately lower on Tuesday, as leading exporters remained weighed down by caution over the currency market, brokers said.
Many participants retreated to the sidelines, waiting for clearer direction from the market. Trade was subdued due to the absence of foreign investors and domestic dealers, they said.
The 225-share Nikkei average lost 153.61 points or 0.77 percent to finish at 19,889.89. Its June futures were down 290 points at 19,860.
Mitsubishi Plastics Industries Ltd, another issue involved in ICs, gained 49 yen, or 11.67 percent, to end at 469. It was the third largest percentage gainer.
Shares of Oki Electric Industry Co Ltd slipped 21 yen to close at 585 on grim group earnings announced on Monday.
On the other hand, electric wire and cable maker Fujikura Ltd climbed to a high for calendar 1997 on a robust earnings announcement. It closed 14 yen higher at 992.
In sectors, decliners were led by ship building, real estate, railway/bus, pulp/paper, and gas. The major gainers were non-ferrous metals, iron/steel, and electric equipment.
The second section index was up 2.29 points at 1,762.76, with 9.43 million shares traded.
The over-the-counter (OTC) index was down 0.03 point at 1,179.92.
